metricText: Total financial irregularities printed by the Ghana Audit Service in the consolidated Ministries, Departments and Other Agencies annual report for a fixed audited year.
note: PROPOSED: The official 2025 MDA report prints an unambiguous total, but admission requires a new gh-audit-annual-report-pdf parser and authenticated release-time capture custody. The plan's ghaudit.org URL redirected away from the agency during verification, so the request pins the current official audit.gov.gh venue printed in the report itself. gh-vfm-office-act-2026 is a reserved future bills/ slug; no such entry exists yet. GHS may need an entry in the site Unit union at registration time; that registration concern is not a blocker for this request.
statisticalProduct: Consolidated Report of the Auditor-General on the Public Accounts of Ghana: Ministries, Departments and Other Agencies (MDAs)

verification.reason: The current official annual PDF prints one total financial-irregularities amount for audited year 2025 in paragraph 14 and confirms it in Table 1A. This one post-release fetch supplies parser evidence but does not authenticate first-print bytes or establish a reviewed adapter family.

artifact.printedSentence: The overall financial impact of weaknesses and irregularities identified in the course of the audit amounted to GH¢5,266,315,079. A summary is provided below as Table ‘1A’.

firstPrint.blocker: A current fetch of a one-shot annual PDF does not prove the release-time first print or preserve later replacements under authenticated custody.

requiredWork: Implement and review a Ghana Audit Service annual-report PDF parser that selects the fixed audited year and extracts the Table 1A Total GH¢ value with paragraph 14 as a cross-check.
Add release-time witnessed or versioned capture custody for each annual PDF before admission, with genuine annual-edition pins used to validate title, page, row, currency, and revision handling.
parseNotes: Use the printed Total in the TOTAL GH¢ column after incorporating the report's stated Bank of Ghana conversion of any US-dollar irregularities; do not use the pre-conversion GH¢ subtotal.
The report-printed page is 7 for paragraph 14 and 8 for Table 1A; the corresponding one-indexed physical PDF pages are 9 and 10.
